VICTOIRE de Master Yi

Pack of Wonders.tx: exhaust: Return another friendly gear, unit, or [Hidden] card to its owner's hand.

Turn to Dust.tx: Give a gear [Temporary]. (Kill it at the start of its controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.)

Deadly Flourish.tx: Deal 3 to an enemy unit. When it dies this turn, play a Gold gear token exhausted. (It has "[Reaction][>] Kill this, exhaust: [Add] 1 rune of any type.")

Ezreal, Prodigy.tx: When you play me, discard 1, then draw 2. Optional additional costs you pay cost 1 energy or 1 rune of any type less.

Master Yi, Tempered.tx: [Hunt 2] (When I conquer or hold, gain 2 XP.) [Level 6][>] I have [Deflect] and [Ganking]. (While you have 6+ XP, opponents must pay 1 rune of any type to choose me with a spell or ability and I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)

Ruin Runner.tx: I can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities.

En Garde.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Give a friendly unit +1 might this turn, then an additional +1 might this turn if it is the only unit you control there.

Sprite Fountain.tx: [Temporary] (Kill this at the start of its controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.) When you play this, play a ready 3 might Sprite unit token with [Temporary] to your base. [Deathknell][>] Repeat this gear's play effect. (When this dies, get the effect.)

Sabotage.tx: Choose an opponent. They reveal their hand. Choose a non-unit card from it, and recycle that card.

Vex, Apathetic.tx: [Deflect] (Opponents must pay 1 rune of any type to choose me with a spell or ability.) When an opponent plays a unit while I'm at a battlefield, [Stun] it. They can't move it this turn. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)

Pit Rookie.tx: When you play me, buff another friendly unit. (If it doesn't have a buff, it gets a +1 might buff.)

Akali, Silent.tx: I can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities unless I'm in combat. When I move to a battlefield, give me +2 might this turn.

Gust.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Return a unit at a battlefield with 3 might or less to its owner's hand.

Rampage.tx: As you play this, you may pay 1 body rune as an additional cost. Choose a friendly unit and an enemy unit. If you paid the additional cost, give the friendly unit +2 might this turn. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.

Fizz, Trickster.tx: When you play me, you may play a spell from your trash with Energy cost no more than 3 energy, ignoring its Energy cost. Recycle that spell after you play it. (You must still pay its Power cost.)

Stacked Deck.tx: [Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) Look at the top 3 cards of your Main Deck. Put 1 into your hand and recycle the rest.

Thousand-Tailed Watcher.tx: [Accelerate] (You may pay 1 energy and 1 mind rune as an additional cost to have me enter ready.) When you play me, give enemy units -3 might this turn, to a minimum of 1 might.

The List.tx: As you play this, name a tag. (For example, Miss Fortune, Demacia, and Poro are tags.) exhaust: Give a unit with the named tag -2 might this turn.

Lonely Poro.tx: [Deathknell] — If I died alone, draw 1. (When I die, get the effect. I'm alone if there are no other friendly units here.)

Wages of Pain.tx: [Hidden] (Hide now for 1 rune of any type to react with later for 0 energy.) [Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield. Play a Gold gear token exhausted.

Master Yi, Wuju Bladesman.tx: While a friendly unit defends alone, it gets +2 might.

Legion Marauder.tx: [Empower] — 1 energy or 1 body rune (Pay either cost: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.) [Empowered][>] I have +1 might.

Discipline.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Give a unit +2 might this turn. Draw 1.

Zhonya's Hourglass.tx: [Hidden] (Hide now for 1 rune of any type to react with later for 0 energy.) The next time a friendly unit would die, kill this instead. Recall that unit exhausted. (Send it to base. This isn't a move.)

First Mate.tx: When you play me, ready another unit.

Rengar, Trophy Hunter.tx: [Ambush] (You may play me as a [Reaction] to a battlefield where you have units.) I can be played to a battlefield where there are enemy units (even if you don't have units there).

Stupefy.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Give a unit -1 might this turn, to a minimum of 1 might. Draw 1.

Eclipse.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Give a unit -4 might this turn. [Predict]. (Look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)

Bellows Breath.tx: [Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) [Repeat] 1 energy and 1 mind rune (You may pay the additional cost to repeat this spell's effect.) Deal 1 to up to three units at the same location.

Onslaught.tx: Give a unit +6 might this turn. [Flow] 4 energy (You may play this from your trash for its Flow cost. Then banish it.)

Star-Crossed.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Return a friendly unit and an enemy unit to their owners' hands.

Punch First.tx: [Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) Give a unit +5 might this turn.

Treasure Trove.tx: When this leaves the board, draw 1 and channel 1 rune exhausted. 1 chaos rune, exhaust: Kill this.

Defy.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Counter a spell that costs no more than 4 energy and no more than 1 rune of any type.

Bewitching Spirit.tx: When you play me, choose a player. They discard 1.

Ezreal, Prodigal Explorer.tx: exhaust: [Reaction] — Draw 1. Use only if you've chosen enemy units and/or gear twice this turn with spells or unit abilities.

Scuttle Crab.tx: (Units with 0 might can conquer and hold.) When you play me, draw 1. [Deathknell][>] Choose an opponent. They reveal their hand. You can look at their facedown cards this turn. Gain 1 XP. (When I die, get the effects.)
